flat_fee.notes: EC2/EBS billed by AWS to your account at AWS prices; RunsOn license EUR 300-3,600/year per company, sized by jobs per month.

notes: RunsOn Flex predefined runner "4cpu-linux-arm64" (EC2 families c8g, c9g, m8g, m9g; memory any; Spot by default, spot=false for on-demand). $0 is RunsOn's per-minute charge only: the EC2 instance, EBS and traffic are billed by AWS to your account at AWS prices (to the second); RunsOn adds a flat annual license. See the provider notes. Memory is published as "any" (depends on the EC2 instance picked), so memory_gb is left out. Root disk: an EBS volume whose size is set per job with the volume= label; the docs do not publish a default size, so disk_gb is left out.
